retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered group portrait featuring men in formal attire against a bright background with distinctive stencil-cut display typography.
triggerTerms: men in white tuxedos with afros

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, triangular composition of five men with afro hairstyles wearing white tuxedos and dark bowties, set against a stark white studio background. The typography is characterized by a heavy, geometric stencil style with visible bridges.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of subjects creating depth
High contrast between dark skin/hair and white clothing/background
Top-left alignment of heavy stencil text
Uniformity in attire contrasting with individual facial expressions

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a tiered formation filling the lower two-thirds and right side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure at the top of the triangle provides the vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold text in the top left, down through the faces in a clockwise spiral.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left quadrant to accommodate the primary title.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue (secondary text) and warm skin tones
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with natural skin saturation and deep blacks.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, black, and one primary accent color for text.

letterConstructionRules: Consistent vertical stencil gaps (bridges) in every character
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is split into two vertical halves
The 'A' has a horizontal bridge through the crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same stencil family used in different colors for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric foundation and heavy weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of five Black men with afros wearing white tuxedos with black lapels, arranged in a tiered triangular group against a solid white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, geometric stencil-cut uppercase text in the top-left corner using a heavy weight and tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Are there visible stencil bridges in every letter?
Are the subjects wearing white tuxedos?
Is the text aligned to the top left?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no overlapping of text and faces
Check that stencil cuts are consistent across all letters
Verify the white of the suits is distinct from the white background
Confirm the triangular composition is balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Group Portrait + White Tuxedos + High-Key Background + Geometric Stencil Display Type
